sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु भद्रेण राघवो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।कथयस्व यथातत्त्वं सर्वं निरवशेषतः ।। ७.४३.९ ॥
transliteration: evamuktastu bhadreṇa rāghavo vākyamabravīt ।kathayasva yathātattvaṁ sarvaṁ niravaśeṣataḥ ।। 7.43.9 ॥

translations.english: When Bhadra had thus spoken, Rama indeed replied, "Tell everything truthfully and completely, without omitting anything."
